title: Pocket FFM launch access model
summary: Cole approved distribution-gated open registration with email verification and accepted limited referral leakage outside FFM.
evidence: A QR code will be shown to approximately 1,000 pre-vetted FFM attendees.
Anyone with the shared link may register free after proving email ownership.
No member roster, CSV allowlist, password, or model call is required during registration.
The beta-code path remains available behind an environment flag.
Load testing must cover 1,000 landing hits and at least 300 registrations inside 3 minutes before steady answer traffic.
limitations: Distribution is intended for the FFM community, but strict membership enforcement and minor referral leakage are intentionally out of scope for launch.
